metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic still life of a clear glass filled with ice cubes and dark liquid, resting on a sunlit wooden table. Heavy condensation droplets cling to the exterior of the glass, and a distinct wet ring has formed on the wood beneath it. Warm ambient lighting, highly detailed textures, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Condensation naturally forms on cold surfaces in warm, humid environments, creating droplets and wet rings.
